# Mark Darren Oandasan (BootlegYouki)

Mark Darren Oandasan (known online as **BootlegYouki**) is a Full-Stack Software Engineer, Mobile Application Developer, and UI/UX Designer based in Quezon City, Philippines. He specializes in building high-fidelity web and mobile applications featuring retro-brutalist and TUI (Terminal User Interface) design systems, clean UX animations, and deep AI/LLM agent integrations.

- **Location:** Quezon City, Philippines
- **Portfolio Website:** <https://bootlegyouki.github.io/>
- **GitHub:** <https://github.com/BootlegYouki>
- **Email:** <bootlegyouki@gmail.com>

---

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend & Web:** Svelte 5, SvelteKit, React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Bootstrap, GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), Lenis Scroll
- **Mobile Development:** React Native, Expo, Expo Notifications, Sideloading (iOS/Android packaging)
- **Backend & Cloud:** Tauri v2 (Rust backend), SQLite, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Google Drive API (OAuth2)
- **AI & Integrations:** Mistral AI, Ollama, OpenRouter, Google Gemini APIs, Agentic Workflows, Tool Calling, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

---

## Featured Projects

### 1. Kwiz
An AI-powered educational ecosystem. Uses Mistral AI to automatically generate quizzes from text prompts or PDF documents.
- **Stack:** Tauri v2, React Native, Expo, React 19, TypeScript, Mistral AI, custom TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) format
- **Repository:** <https://github.com/BootlegYouki/Kwiz>

### 2. At iba pa POS & IMS
A real-time desktop POS (Point of Sale) and IMS (Inventory Management System) built for a local client. Features offline-first operations, LAN-based real-time syncing, and cloud mirroring.
- **Stack:** Tauri v2 (Rust), React, TypeScript, SQLite, Supabase, Ollama (local/cloud AI agent workflows)
- **Repository:** <https://github.com/BootlegYouki/at-iba-pa>

### 3. BootHub
A cross-platform clipboard ecosystem for syncing text, files, and images between mobile devices and PC.
- **Stack:** Tauri v2, React Native, Expo, React 19, TypeScript, Google Drive API (OAuth2)
- **Repository:** <https://github.com/BootlegYouki/BootHub>

### 4. Vaultleg
An offline-first mobile personal finance tracker. Uses a custom TUI (Terminal User Interface) design system and GitHub Gist syncing.
- **Stack:** React Native, Expo, TypeScript, AsyncStorage, GitHub Gist Sync
- **Repository:** <https://github.com/BootlegYouki/VaultlegV2>

### 5. BootSked
An offline-first daily routine scheduler with push notifications and study session logs.
- **Stack:** React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Expo Notifications
- **Repository:** <https://github.com/BootlegYouki/BootSked>

### 6. Student Management System (SET-2)
A Philippine DepEd curriculum-compliant portal for students, teachers, and admins. Includes dual AI engine grading analytics.
- **Stack:** SvelteKit, Svelte 5, Electron, MongoDB, OpenRouter API, Google AI, PDFKit
- **Repository:** <https://github.com/BootlegYouki/set-2-system>

### 7. Beyond Doubt (BYD) Clothing E-Commerce
A streetwear e-commerce platform with customer support AI chatbots and interactive delivery maps.
- **Stack:** PHP, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Leaflet Maps, AI Chatbot API, PostgreSQL
- **Repository:** <https://github.com/BootlegYouki/BYD-Clothing-E-Commerce>

### 8. Marigold Video Scanner
A bespoke client workflow automation mobile app to scan barcodes, record videos, and stamp metadata in real-time.
- **Stack:** React Native, Expo, Kotlin (native Android vision modification), Google Drive API
